html:
EcomHalo partnered with MarketJoy to develop a structured outbound program designed to generate a consistent pipeline of high-value opportunities in the eCommerce space.

Instead of relying on sporadic wins, the focus was on setting up a reliable system that consistently generates qualified sales conversations across multiple channels.

The Challenge

EcomHalo’s outbound efforts lacked cohesion and predictability:

They needed a more unified approach that could turn outbound activity into a measurable pipeline.

Outreach channels operated in silos

Lead generation was inconsistent

Engagement rarely translates into real sales discussions

The MarketJoy Strategy

MarketJoy introduced a synchronized outreach model designed to drive both engagement and conversion.

Key components included:

  • Highly targeted email sequences focused on eCommerce-specific challenges
  • Dedicated call campaigns to engage prospects directly
  • Messaging customized by role and business context
  • Ongoing performance analysis to refine targeting and improve outcomes

The emphasis was on creating a system that consistently produces meaningful sales interactions.

The Results

23 Pipeline-Ready Leads Delivered in the first months of service

Established a dependable outbound motion capable of ongoing production

This enabled:

  • More efficient use of the sales team’s time
  • Faster progression from outreach to opportunity
  • Improved overall pipeline quality

Balanced Channel Contribution

Outreach success was evenly distributed:

  • 12 leads sourced through email campaigns
  • 11 leads generated via phone outreach

This balance highlights a well-integrated, multi-touch strategy

Higher Engagement Through Channel Alignment

  • Email efforts opened doors and created initial interest
  • Calling initiatives accelerated conversations and secured responses
  • Together, they drove stronger overall conversion performance

Focused on the Right Buyers

  • Prospects closely matched EcomHalo’s target customer profile
  • Engagements included relevant stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Outreach prioritized fit and intent over sheer volume

Lead Value & Sales Impact

MarketJoy delivered:

  • Engaged prospects ready for direct follow-up
  • Opportunities with clear alignment to EcomHalo’s offerings
  • Conversations that could progress through the sales funnel

Business Outcomes

With MarketJoy, EcomHalo transitioned to a more effective outbound model:

  • Sustained pipeline generation across channels
  • Sharper targeting and messaging precision
  • Improved conversion from outreach to live discussions
  • A repeatable framework for scaling outbound efforts

The Bottom Line

MarketJoy helped EcomHalo turn disconnected outreach into a cohesive, results-driven pipeline strategy.

For companies aiming to:

This is what a well-executed system delivers.

Activate both email and phone outreach effectively

Drive consistent, high-quality sales conversations

Build an outbound engine that supports long-term growth
